# Multipart v0.6.1 - Table of Contents

> Multipart message generator

## Modules

- [Multipart](https://multipart.hexdocs.pm/Multipart.md): `Multipart` constructs multipart messages.
- [Multipart.Part](https://multipart.hexdocs.pm/Multipart.Part.md): Represents an individual part of a `Multipart` message.
